title: Streamer Arrest Sparks Probe: Los Angeles police hold Salazar; attempted murder allegation remains
summary_full: Kick streamer and TikTok creator Santos Salazar was arrested in Los Angeles following a reported domestic violence incident and is facing an attempted murder allegation. His bail was reportedly set at $1 million. Salazar and partner Brianna Olsen recently welcomed their son, Sunday Ray, and shared family updates online. Olsen later posted footage appearing to show Salazar’s arrest and said she had been speaking with lawyers. The investigation remains ongoing.
